# Copilot Code Review Instructions for Engineering Code

For review comments on files under `eng/`:

- Keep each comment short and actionable. State the concrete impact and required fix without
  restating the surrounding code.
- Do not prefix comments with priority labels such as `P0`, `P1`, `P2`, or `P3`.
